## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals leading (Industrials: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND; GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND). Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 across 3 sectors).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +0.16%) ABOVE TREND and XEL (+50 sentiment) showing strength; Energy: OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +11.40%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND and GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Staples soft: EL (1W: +7.34% | 1M: -3.09%) RECOVERY and MDLZ (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION show mixed action; Materials weak: NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND and DOW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: +7.43%) CORRECTION; Technology shows internal dispersion despite 1W positive (see Tech section).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 across 3 sectors), signaling cyclical/tech pockets of strength.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -4.34% | 1M: +10.48%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -4.37% | 1M: -27.50%) BELOW TREND, NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in legacy tech and select materials names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND. Watch for MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple large caps (GOOGL, AMZN, SHOP) show 1W up vs 1M down — tactical opportunities but suppresses overconfident regime calls.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but constructive: AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND contrast with MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND; Sector 1W: +1.04% across 24 stocks — internal rotation, watch for leadership concentration.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Health in Financials: JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND and PYPL (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%) RECOVERY show divergent drivers while V (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -0.20% | 1M: -0.22%) BELOW TREND lag; Sector 1W: +2.06% (20 stocks) — favor cyclical financial exposure but monitor bifurcation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed but watchable: JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION (bullish FDA news +75 confirms upside longer term), UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY faces negative sentiment (-50) — divergence, LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +0.23% (17 stocks) — defensive names steady, biotech/large-caps mixed.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Industrials and Energy cyclicals (DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND) and selective Financials (JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to lagging large-cap software and chip names showing BELOW TREND (INTU, INTC, ORCL). Style: Value/Cyclical over Growth given breadth and leadership concentration; monitor the multi-name divergence for trend confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND — all have momentum and/or positive news. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND hit as tech weakness confirmed; watch UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY amid negative guidance.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +2.22%), Energy (1W: +2.35%) and Financials (1W: +2.06%) given leadership and earnings/news tailwinds. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -0.45%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -0.28%) where names are mixed and multiple stocks in CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND — hold weekly support or risk trend change; AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND — watch 1M uptrend for continuation; JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND — a breakout above recent weekly highs would confirm Financial leadership; MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim short-term resistance risks deeper pullback.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
DE (+80): DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/guidance news confirmed by sharp price action. JNJ (+75): JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION — FDA breakthrough news aligns with 1M strength (confirmation). PFE (+55): PFE (1W: -2.99% | 1M: +4.66%) CORRECTION — positive trial results but short-term pullback; watch follow-through. LLY (+60): LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — strong trial news but price still lagging (divergence to monitor).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TSLA (-55): TSLA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: -4.55%) BELOW TREND — negative fleet/robotaxi headlines confirm deterioration. UNH (-50): UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY — analyst downgrades diverge from 1W bounce, watch guidance for confirmation. SBUX (-90): SBUX (news -90) — extreme negative sentiment is a material risk; monitor price action (news confirms distribution if price fails to stabilize).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style. DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND and OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (GOOGL/AMZN/SHOP vs MSFT/INTC) and negative headlines on TSLA and SBUX warrant monitoring for trend confirmation.
